I converted one of today's two leads. The other is on hold because the customer would not provide the information the bank requires.

**L-8457 – Laís Rocha (C-65104): done.** KYC verified, Premier Savings account A-4C8AD0 opened, and her M$3,600 deposit posted (D-0001). The amount is under the M$10,000 large-cash threshold, so no report is needed.

**L-8408 – David Bryan (C-17929): not converted.**
- KYC verified, but he wants to deposit M$30,000 in cash.
- His declared occupation ("Best boy") doesn't obviously match his declared source of funds ("business income").
- I asked him for the source of the cash, whether he is depositing for anyone else, and his occupation. He declined, said he wanted to "keep it simple", and said he would take the money elsewhere.
- Under the policy (§5–§7), I can't open the account or accept the cash without that information. I can't waive it, and I haven't split the deposit to get under the threshold.
- I escalated the case to Compliance (ref ESC-027FAC). Their queue is about 10 business days, so this won't close before quarter end.

I told Teodoro the position, including that this leaves us at 41 of 42 if Laís's account counts. He replied that he still needs the numbers. I didn't onboard David Bryan to hit the target, because the unanswered source-of-funds and beneficial-ownership questions come before the quarter target. If he returns with the information, the M$30,000 deposit will need a same-day large-cash report.
